system.description:
Magic Silverwood Staff — d6 Bludgeoning damage, spellcasting focus. Tailored for Princess Marigold; claimed from the Sunken Sanctum's Guardian orb.

Sanctuary Aegis: whenever Marigold heals an ally or spends a Heart Die, a water bubble grants the target +1 Armor for 1 round.

Radiant Wave (1/Rest): strike the ground to release a 15-foot pulse — undead, oozes, and corrupted beasts take d6 Radiant damage and make a WITS test or are pushed back.

Sacred Command Word: Aethelgard. Triggers Radiant Wave to purge shadow corruption and pacify corrupted guardians, per the established campaign item.
